descriptive traits.personality trait: You see omens in every event and action. The gods try to speak to us, if only we had the wisdom to listen.
descriptive traits.ideal: Faith: You trust that your deity will guide your actions. If you work hard, things will go well.
descriptive traits.bond: The sacred texts of your temple are your greatest responsibility. You would sacrifice anything to protect them.
descriptive traits.flaw: You judge others harshly, and yourself even more severely.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I believe that anything worth doing is worth doing right. I can't help it—I'm a perfectionist.
descriptive traits.ideal: Community: It is the duty of all civilized people to strengthen the bonds of community and family.
descriptive traits.bond: The workshop where I learned my trade is the most important place in the world to me.
descriptive traits.flaw: I'll do anything to get my hands on something rare or priceless.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I lie about almost everything, even when there's no good reason to.
descriptive traits.ideal: Independence: I am a free spirit—no one tells me what to do.
descriptive traits.bond: I owe a debt I can never repay to the person who took pity on me as a child.
descriptive traits.flaw: I can't resist swindling people who are more powerful than me.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I always have a plan for what to do when things go wrong.
descriptive traits.ideal: Freedom: Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them.
descriptive traits.bond: I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a generous benefactor.
descriptive traits.flaw: When I see something valuable, I can't think of anything but how to steal it.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I know a story relevant to almost every situation.
descriptive traits.ideal: Creativity: The world is in need of new ideas and bold action.
descriptive traits.bond: I want to be famous, whatever it takes.
descriptive traits.flaw: I have trouble keeping my true feelings hidden. My sharp tongue lands me in trouble.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I'm used to helping out those who don't know much about life on the land.
descriptive traits.ideal: Tradition: The old stories, customs, and songs must never be forgotten, for they teach us who we are.
descriptive traits.bond: My family is everything. I would do anything to protect them.
descriptive traits.flaw: I am suspicious of strangers and expect the worst of them.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I'm always polite and respectful to those I meet.
descriptive traits.ideal: Responsibility: I do what I must and obey just authority.
descriptive traits.bond: Someone saved my life when I was in danger. To this day, I will never leave a friend behind.
descriptive traits.flaw: I have a weakness for the vices of the city, especially strong drink.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I'm always looking to the horizon, wondering what lies beyond.
descriptive traits.ideal: Nature: The natural world is more important than all the constructs of civilization.
descriptive traits.bond: I want to explore every wild place in the world before my days are done.
descriptive traits.flaw: I don't pay attention to risks in a situation. Never tell me the odds.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I've been isolated for so long that I rarely speak, preferring gestures and expressions.
descriptive traits.ideal: Self-Knowledge: If you know yourself, there is nothing left to truly know.
descriptive traits.bond: I entered seclusion to hide from those who might still be hunting me. I must someday confront them.
descriptive traits.flaw: I am dogmatic in my thinking, unable to admit the possibility that I may be wrong.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I'm a born negotiator who can't help evaluating everything as a potential deal.
descriptive traits.ideal: Aspiration: I'm determined to make something of myself, and my wealth is only the beginning.
descriptive traits.bond: My business partner betrayed me. Someday soon I'll have my revenge.
descriptive traits.flaw: I'm too greedy for my own good. I can't resist taking a risk if there's money involved.

descriptive traits.personality trait: My favor, once lost, is lost forever.
descriptive traits.ideal: Responsibility: It is my duty to respect the authority of my family and to protect those who depend on me.
descriptive traits.bond: I will face any challenge to win the approval of my family.
descriptive traits.flaw: I secretly believe that everyone else is beneath me.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I use polysyllabic words that convey the impression of great erudition.
descriptive traits.ideal: Knowledge: The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge.
descriptive traits.bond: I have a great library, and I am always seeking to expand its contents.
descriptive traits.flaw: I speak without really thinking through my words, invariably insulting others.

descriptive traits.personality trait: My friends know they can rely on me, no matter what.
descriptive traits.ideal: Change: Life is like the sea—ever-shifting, and those who cannot adapt are lost.
descriptive traits.bond: I'll always remember the first vessel I crewed and the sailors who taught me my trade.
descriptive traits.flaw: My pride will probably lead to my destruction.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I am methodical and deliberate in my work, taking great care to record things accurately.
descriptive traits.ideal: Truth: Every lie is a tarnish on the soul of its teller. Records must be kept faithfully.
descriptive traits.bond: I protect a secret hidden in the archives I once tended—a secret that could spell disaster if revealed.
descriptive traits.flaw: I am easily distracted by the promise of new information.

descriptive traits.ideal: Greater Good: Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others.
descriptive traits.bond: Those who fight beside me are those worth dying for.
descriptive traits.flaw: I made a terrible mistake in battle that cost many lives, and I would do anything to keep that secret.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I have a story for every occasion, drawn from a life of hard travel.
descriptive traits.ideal: People: I help the people who help me—that's what keeps us alive out on the road.
descriptive traits.bond: I want to see every corner of the world before my time is done.
descriptive traits.flaw: The best way to get me to do something is to tell me I can't do it.
